{{Top|leg}}
A '''glitterstim bite''' was a confection consisting of a tiny quantity of [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] encased in a lightproof, sweet carbohydrate shell.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Unidentified Rodian glitterstim dealer|dealer]] sold glitterstim bites to an [[Unidentified Aqualish assassin|Aqualish]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] at a [[Unidentified Coruscant pedestrian market|pedestrian market]] on the  [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The Aqualish warned the Rodian that if the spice wasn't genuine, he would return and [[Death/Legends|kill]] him. Frightened, the Rodian assured the Aqualish that it was genuine and gave him an extra bag of glitterstim bites free of charge.<ref name="MK" />
